Command: Do not cease hating the enticer to idolatry
Summary: One of the Deuteronomy 13 safeguards against idolatry: do not cease hating the enticer to idolatry. The chapter treats enticement to idolatry as a public danger to the whole community, not a private opinion.
Commandment: Do not cease hating the enticer to idolatry
Application: Scripture's stated reason: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul (Deuteronomy 13:3). These civil penalties belonged to ancient Israel's theocracy; the refusal to follow idolatrous leading endures.
